run_IndexPQ_polysemous_benchmark: run a benchmark comparing FAISS IndexPQ baseline search against polysemous search on the SIFT1M dataset
create_IndexPQ_with_polysemous_training: create a FAISS IndexPQ with 16 subquantizers and enable polysemous training for improved recall
test_polysemous_ht_values: test different polysemous_ht values from 64 down to 30 to find the best recall-latency tradeoff
review_IndexPQ_search_type: review the FAISS IndexPQ search_type options ST_PQ and ST_polysemous and their impact on recall
summarize_sift1m_evaluation: summarize the SIFT1M dataset evaluation results showing ms per query and R@1 recall for each search configuration
